q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an electric iron?
title: Electric iron carbon footprint per piece
short: Add the aluminium soleplate, heating element, thermostat, plastic body and cord per iron with supplier figures. Add casting, moulding, assembly and testing energy, then divide by irons passed and report by wattage and type.
audience: Electric iron and small appliance makers

ul: Die cast aluminium soleplate with coating.
Die casting and machining if in-house.

p: Report per iron with weight and type, dry or steam. The soleplate is usually the heaviest metal part.

example.title: Worked example: electric iron unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 19,800 / 60,000 = 0.330 kg CO2 per piece
Add soleplate, element and body for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
